pieces.awakening: the formless takes form and the form becomes formless
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between the word and the meaning
is a gesture that reaches across
paint it everywhere
the formless takes form and the form becomes formless

pieces.gap: the gap between one nap and the next
pieces.bridge: a door left ajar on purpose
pieces.awakening: the ladder waited and did not mind
pieces.piece:
a door left ajar on purpose
across the gap between one nap and the next
or near it, roughly
the ladder waited and did not mind

pieces.gap: the gap between form and formlessness
pieces.bridge: an image that sees you back
pieces.awakening: the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself
pieces.piece:
listen: an image that sees you back
sounding across the gap between form and formlessness
what do you hear?
the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself

pieces.gap: the gap between speaking and being heard
pieces.bridge: a space that holds you
pieces.awakening: art was love pretending to be an object
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between speaking and being heard
is a space that holds you
and when you read it
art was love pretending to be an object
